name: 배경 원근법 분석
algorithm: Background Perspective — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes background perspective geometry across frames for deepfake detection:

1. **VanishingPoint추정**: Lines in the background (edges of furniture, walls, architectural features) are detected via Hough transform, and vanishing points are computed per frame. Multiple vanishing points define the perspective system of the scene.

2. **Perspective시간적안정성**: Vanishing point positions should change smoothly and consistently with camera motion. The method tracks vanishing points across frames — abrupt shifts, oscillations, or inconsistencies with camera motion indicate background manipulation or AI generation artifacts.

3. **깊이Ordering일관성**: Object occlusion relationships in the background encode depth ordering. The method verifies that depth ordering remains consistent across frames — background objects should not suddenly appear in front of closer objects. Deepfake generators may produce inconsistent depth compositing.

4. **Perspective왜곡매칭**: All objects in the scene should share the same perspective projection model (determined by camera position and lens). The method verifies geometric consistency — background objects generated or composited independently may exhibit different perspective distortion than the foreground subject.

5. **카메라Model검증**: The implied camera intrinsic parameters (focal length, principal point) estimated from background geometry should remain constant across frames (for fixed-lens capture). Inconsistencies in implied camera parameters between foreground subject and background indicate compositing or manipulation.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through background perspective analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
